result.title: WL-SeqVAE: Sequence-Based Graph Generation Using Variational Autoencoders and Weisfeiler-Leman Colors
result.summary: In this paper, we introduce WL-SeqVAE, a sequence-based variational autoencoder for generating graphs. The key observation behind WL-SeqVAE is that node colors induced by the Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) algorithm provide compact discrete summaries of local graph structure and can therefore serve as structural tokens for generation. Rather than learning a distribution over adjacency matrices directly, our method maps each graph to a sequence of WL colors and employs a variational autoencoder that encodes this sequence into a Gaussian latent distribution, from which an autoregressive decoder reconstructs the graph. During generation, compatibility constraints derived from the WL colors guide node and edge predictions, combining global information from the latent representation with local structural consistency. This formulation turns graph generation into a sequence generation problem and avoids directly parameterizing a quadratic adjacency matrix. We evaluate WL-SeqVAE on molecular and general graph generation tasks. Across the evaluated datasets, WL-SeqVAE is competitive with established baselines on several local structural and molecular quality metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/iakovosevdaimon/WL-SeqVAE

AI.brief_summary: WL-SeqVAE 将图映射为 Weisfeiler-Leman 颜色序列，用变分自编码器把该序列编码为高斯潜分布，再由自回归解码器重建图，并以 WL 颜色导出的兼容性约束指导节点与边的预测，从而把图生成转为序列生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散结构摘要 token + 全局潜变量 + 约束式自回归解码」的组合，可能为 LVR 中把视觉实体关系压缩为离散结构状态、并在解码时保持结构一致性提供概念线索，具体可迁移性有待核查。
